knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Removing crusted matter first lets the solution reach the surface. Pouring a second product in risks a mixture.
A damp interior supports odour and leaves rings. Drying before relining is the method.
Plastic and nylon are less likely to scratch the bin surface than steel or wire.
The when a bin needs more than a wipe section says to decide first whether the soil is light or heavy, because that choice sets the method.

practicalCriteria: Chooses light or heavy method from the soil present, and states the reason before starting.
Scrapes crusted matter before soaking, and applies the product at the label strength.
Dries the inside fully, fits a fresh liner, and returns the bin to its place with no residue at the seams or base.
passRule: Knowledge checks: 80% pass mark, which for three questions means all three correct. Practical sign-off is separate and observed by an assessor.
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of one heavy-soil and one light-soil bin clean
Site record for any heavy-soil bin
stopWorkCriteria: Two cleaning products mixed in one bin
A wet bin returned to service with a liner fitted
